frozen_by: CH-13 (2026-11-09, Badabuba / worker Claude); rule results/ch-13-inference/selection_rule.md (commit 2b658d0, before any CH-13 result), evidence results/ch-13-inference/selection.json and comparison.csv
description: RT-DETR-l, no retraining. Per frame 6 passes at imgsz 1344 (stretched square, as in training): the full frame, its horizontal flip (boxes un-flipped), and a 2x2 grid of tiles of 0.6 W x 0.6 H (0.2 overlap, frame aspect kept, about 1.67x zoom). Each pass is decoded the Ultralytics way (top 300 (query, class) pairs, score > 0.001); all boxes are shifted to frame pixels and merged by class-wise NMS at IoU 0.5 (torchvision batched_nms); then the top 500 per frame by score.
implementation: movd.infer.predict_image(models={'baseline': <RTDETR model>}, image=<BGR frame>, config=<this config>, device='0') -> movd.infer.Dets (xyxy frame pixels, class 0-7); movd.infer.to_coco(image_id, dets) -> COCO results for the CH-05 writer (movd.submission.build_rows clips out-of-frame boxes). The 'baseline' key names the checkpoint the passes use: in CH-14 it is the model being submitted (final_rtdetr, or the rtdetr_baseline fallback)

speed_cost.scope: end to end, batch 1, FP32, first 30 val_full frames preloaded (no disk I/O); results/ch-13-inference/speed/
